detailed_descriptions.en: The DLC contains 5 additional missions, 2 new recruitable heroes and 3 new technologies. New Missions: Medical Ethics (Sector 4) Infinite Regress (Sector 8) Counterpoint (Sector 9) Friendship One (Sector 11) Good Shepherd (Sector 11)
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: DLC包括5项额外任务，2名可以招募的新英雄，以及3项新科技
detailed_descriptions.ja: DLCには、5つの追加ミッションと、仲間にできる2人の新たなヒーロー、さらに3つの新技術が収録
